name: 01904 · Lynn, MA
findings: ZIP 01904 (Lynn) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01904 (Lynn) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
